metricSemantics.correctness: Exact terminal, disposition, confidence, required machine-signal, and insufficient-evidence null checks; not semantic entailment.
metricSemantics.citations: Exact retained eligible-identifier membership and required citation presence.
metricSemantics.unsupportedClaims: Unknown citations, foreign machine-signal tokens, and cause/recommendation assertions for oracle insufficient-evidence scenarios; not general entailment.
metricSemantics.latency: Completed-at minus requested-at for every terminal attempt.
